coordinates.contour_rule: closed pixel-cell edge rings; odd-even fill; integer vertices

classification.mouth_rule: isolated two-pixel vertical ink component at x>=40, y30..38
classification.arm_ink_rule: body ink inside one-pixel eight-neighbor erosion of body; near arm x<42, far-arm division x>=42

extraction.method: Exact visible regions from each original cel; only collinear path vertices removed. Body includes filled eye/mouth/cheek areas. Feet retain visible occlusion and seams. No limb fitting, interpolation, registration or generated-raster edits.
